intro.body: A quiet sail. Tap, hear, and rock. No rush. Untested, awaiting parent test.
intro.audioText: A quiet sail. Tap the coins and hear the numbers.

technique.title: Tap and hear
technique.body: Hold the little sailor. Tap each coin. Hear one number for each tap. No rush.
technique.audioText: Tap each coin. Hear one number for each tap.

paper.prompt: With a grown-up, draw one round coin. Point to it and say one.

technique.title: Open, then look
technique.body: Tap the chest. When it opens, point to each coin you see.
technique.audioText: Tap the chest. Point to each coin you see.

paper.prompt: Draw a closed chest. Then draw it open with 2 coins.

technique.title: Tap to rock
technique.body: Tap the ship. Hear the wood creak and the water splash. Three taps finish the care voyage.
technique.audioText: Tap the ship. Hear the wood and the water.

paper.prompt: Sway together three times. Count the sways out loud.
